newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS confirms NOVA debt rating.
newsitem.headline: CBRS confirms NOVA debt rating.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Friday it confirmed its general credit rating for NOVA Corp at A (low) following the release of NOVA's 1996 financial results.
The rating outlook was confirmed at stable.
CBRS said the rating reflected the underlying credit strength of subsidiaries NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd and NOVA Chemicals Ltd, which are both active borrowers in public debt marrkets.

Besides incorporating the competitive strength of the entities, NOVA is benefiting from a large increase in income contribution from NOVA Gas International, which has seen higher operating income from natural gas processing and gathering operations of affiliated NGC Corp, CBRS said.
It said NGTL was expected to maintain a consistent profitable trend and its earnings were expected to increase six-eight percent in 1997.

Although the company's chemical unit returns were largely dependent on strength in petrochemical prices, its low-cost production facilities were expected to maintain above-average performance in its sector this year, CBRS said.
